name: I’m Mojdeh, but you can call me Mojo. I’m a graphic designer with 15 years of professional experience, with a strong focus on logo design and brand identity. I create thoughtful, distinctive visual identities that are simple, considered, and built to last. For me, good design starts with understanding the people behind the business. Every brand has its own story, goals, personality, and audience, so I take the time to listen, ask the right questions, and understand what makes each business unique before I begin designing. My style can adapt to the brand and its audience, from bold and playful to clean, minimal, and premium. I don’t believe in using the same approach for every project. Instead, I develop each identity around what feels right for the brand and what it needs to communicate. I believe good design is about more than looking beautiful. It should have a clear purpose, solve problems, build trust, and make a lasting impression. I respect the brief, bring my experience to the table, and work closely with my clients to create design that feels both considered and true to their brand.
